name: e-pharmacy
description: E-PHARMACY monorepo: client storefront, pharmacy cabinet, admin dashboard and shared API.

scripts.check:before-deploy: pnpm check:api-boundaries && pnpm check:next-api-boundaries && pnpm check:next-api-routes && pnpm check:next-api-contracts && pnpm check:validation-contracts && pnpm check:type-contracts && pnpm check:ui-boundaries && pnpm check:ui-styles && pnpm lint && pnpm type-check && pnpm test && pnpm build
scripts.check:client: pnpm --filter @e-pharmacy/client lint && pnpm --filter @e-pharmacy/client type-check && pnpm --filter @e-pharmacy/client build
scripts.check:api: pnpm check:api-boundaries && pnpm --filter @e-pharmacy/api lint && pnpm --filter @e-pharmacy/api type-check && pnpm --filter @e-pharmacy/api test && pnpm --filter @e-pharmacy/api build
scripts.check:pharmacy: pnpm --filter @e-pharmacy/pharmacy lint && pnpm --filter @e-pharmacy/pharmacy type-check && pnpm --filter @e-pharmacy/pharmacy build
scripts.test:contracts: pnpm check:validation-contracts && pnpm check:type-contracts && pnpm --filter @e-pharmacy/validation test && pnpm --filter @e-pharmacy/api test
